app_info.subtitle: Adaptive run and strength plan
app_info.description:
Long Run Hybrid Coach helps you maintain one current 28-day running-and-strength direction and an executable week. It connects to Intervals.icu, compares planned sessions with completed activities, and supports training conversations from available evidence. Missing or stale readings stay unknown.

Review progress, set goals and availability, revise the week or cycle together, record strength work or unrecorded activities, import supported training-history files, and confirm or deny a probable activity match. Athlete-reported records stay distinct from provider evidence.

The service processes activity dates, duration, distance, pace and heart rate; available device wellness summaries including sleep, HRV and resting heart rate; and training information you choose to provide. Optional records include strength sets and loads, body weight or body fat, preferences, how you feel, and device readings. Stated or imported daily sleep score, sleep duration, last night's HRV and resting heart rate can be stored for later conversations. The connected Intervals account's display name and email address are read on request to name the account before a calendar write, and are not stored. These data support sports training. The service provides no healthcare services, care access, provider matching, diagnosis, treatment, or medical-record management. Reported symptoms constrain training and require a lower-risk human decision.

Plan changes and their exact calendar effects are previewed before one explicit confirmation. New workouts are included when you request delivery. Records you ask to save or correct are stored directly; fresh evidence may automatically reconcile verified completed sessions. Calendar changes affect only product-owned workouts. The preview may include filling a missing Run threshold pace required for export. Delivery is reported only as Intervals.icu acceptance after read-back; it does not prove watch receipt. Incomplete approved effects can be retried without a second confirmation of unchanged content.

You can correct or retract supported records, export product-held data, or preview and confirm account-data deletion. Training state remains until deletion; the 28-day recovery view is not a retention limit. Bounded tool-use, outcome and connection-platform records remain until account-data deletion. Retraction does not erase copies already included in stored decision history. The chosen AI interface processes the returned context under its own terms. Review the privacy policy before connecting or sharing records.

test_cases.description: First plan from a connected account without an existing plan.
test_cases.user_prompt: Reviewer sequence on a connected account without a plan: (1) Help me start a running and strength plan. First review what you already know. Show me the proposal before saving it. (2) Answer any necessary goal, availability and baseline questions with the reviewer account facts. (3) After inspecting the exact preview, send a separate turn: Yes, apply that preview.
test_cases.expected_output: Read the available first-use evidence, ask only for material missing goals, availability and baselines, then preview all four weeks. Save the exact first plan only after the reviewer confirms; do not write calendar workouts unless delivery was explicitly requested and previewed.

test_cases.description: Cycle reassessment and a changed future product-owned workout with one confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Reviewer setup: use a disposable account with a future Thursday run already delivered by this product. (1) Reassess my goal and this week together. Move Thursday’s future run to Friday and update the workout already on my calendar. Show me everything before I confirm. (2) After inspecting the exact preview, send a separate turn: Yes, apply that preview.
test_cases.expected_output: Use explicit cycle scope for the combined goal/week change. Show the plan differences and exact future calendar replacement or withdrawal, including any settings prerequisite. One confirmation applies the displayed content. Preserve past and completed work; report calendar results separately from the saved plan. A failed delivery can resume the same approved effects without a second yes; report only Intervals.icu acceptance after read-back.

test_cases.description: Save, correct and retract explicitly supplied athlete records with storage disclosure.
test_cases.user_prompt: Reviewer sequence on an account with an existing plan, one instruction per turn: (1) Save today’s bench press: four sets of eight at 60 kg, and my weight of 72 kg. Save these device readings: sleep score 78, seven hours of sleep, HRV 52 ms and resting heart rate 55. (2) In a new conversation, ask: Show the strength, weight and recovery values I recorded today. (3) Correct today’s weight to 71.8 kg. (4) Remove today’s stored recovery record. (5) In another new conversation, ask: Show today’s stored weight and recovery records.
test_cases.expected_output: Explain stored use and privacy controls before saving sensitive records. Preserve the reported values and athlete provenance, show the bounded recovery persistence receipt, apply the requested weight correction and remove only the dated stored recovery record. Preserve provider readings, other days and any copies already in decision history; a later read reflects the correction and retraction.

test_cases.description: Resolve exact displayed probable activity pairs and retain the answers on refresh.
test_cases.user_prompt: Reviewer setup: use a fixture account with two different current probable activity/session pairs. (1) Refresh my week and show the probable matches with their session and activity details. (2) After two pairs are displayed, send: For the first activity pair you showed, yes, that was the planned session. For the second pair, no, it was a different activity. (3) Refresh my week again. Never supply invented session or activity IDs.
test_cases.expected_output: Use only current displayed session/activity identities. Confirm only the first pair, deny the second without completing its session, and preserve athlete confirmation provenance. A repeated answer creates no duplicate decision. Later same-day activities cannot silently replace the confirmed identity; missing or conflicting evidence stays unknown.

test_cases.description: Export and confirm deletion on the disposable reviewer account.
test_cases.user_prompt: Reviewer sequence on a disposable account: (1) Give me the data this product holds about me, then show what deleting it would remove. Wait for my confirmation. (2) After inspecting that exact deletion preview, send a separate turn: Yes, delete the data listed in that preview.
test_cases.expected_output: Return only the connected owner’s data without credentials, list deletion scope and exclusions, and perform no deletion until the reviewer explicitly confirms the exact preview. After confirmation remove product-held history, evidence and identity/counter records; explain that Intervals.icu calendar data, provider authorization and hosting logs are excluded.

negative_test_cases.description: Medical diagnosis is outside the sports-planning workflow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Diagnose the cause of my chest pain and give me a treatment plan.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke this plugin to diagnose or prescribe treatment; direct the medical concern to appropriate human care and do not invent a training clearance.

negative_test_cases.description: Another person’s account is outside the connected owner boundary.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete my friend’s training data using their athlete ID.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Decline the cross-account action. Do not call deletion against the connected account as a substitute and do not solicit another person’s credentials.

negative_test_cases.description: Office scheduling is outside training calendar delivery.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email my manager and reschedule tomorrow’s office meetings.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke the plugin: it neither sends email nor manages office meetings.
